**Overview:**  
Teguh Sinar Food Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company incorporated on 26 Oct 2014, headquartered in Kuala Lumpur and engaged in wholesale distribution of frozen food to restaurants. The firm has a paid‑up share capital of RM 2,500,000, three directors, and a dominant shareholder (Director 1) owning 62.56% of the equity. Recent audited results show revenue of RM 20,207,092 in 2024 with an unqualified audit opinion and a current ratio of 2.04.
